title: pnpm verify is the mechanical quality gate
context: Quality checks needed to be enforced uniformly before PR is accepted.
decision: pnpm verify must pass before PR is ready. Runs: pnpm build (includes tsc), pnpm test (both runners), pnpm lint (ESLint/clippy/comments), pnpm format:check. pnpm verify:fast available for iteration (skips vite bundle), but final run before commit must be full verify.
consequences: Single command enforces all mechanical gates. Catches: type errors, test failures, lint violations, formatting, missing vite.config.ts entries (bundle step only). Bundle step catches errors that typecheck but cannot bundle.
